queries.name: StockEligibilityQuery
rules: reads Spare Part Unit/current allocation/return/consequence projections only
BOM/serial equality does not prove identity

queries.name: InventoryNeedsQuery
queries.rule: prior fulfillment does not hide active reusable Need

queries.name: SpareRequestListQuery
returns: requester Contact identity + bounded creation-time requester display/context
queries.rule: requester is request-origin authority and is not substituted by current receiver or current Contact affiliation

queries.name: SpareRequestDetailQuery
returns: immutable requester Contact relationship + REQUESTER_CONTEXT_V1 effective at creation
draft allocations/logistics when editable including separate receiver
queries.rule: later Contact affiliation/descriptive changes may be shown as current reference context only when clearly labelled and never overwrite requester creation evidence

queries.name: TaskInventoryContextQuery
queries.rule: Task execution/outcome labels come from LLD-05 reader, not Inventory copies

queries.name: InventoryAttentionQuery
queries.rule: archival/presentation never suppresses unresolved action-required obligation from this surface

queries.name: InventoryHistoryQuery
queries.rule: labels each authority; projection recomputation is not misrepresented as lifecycle evidence

queries.name: PreviewInventoryBulkAction
rules: only semantically compatible eligible targets may form one later atomic bulk acceptance

queries.name: PreviewInventoryHardDelete
returns: CLEAR with exact removable rows/fingerprint or BLOCKED|INDETERMINATE with reasons and protected dependencies
rules: only governing untouched draft kinds are classifiable
accepted lifecycle history never becomes deletable through archive/presentation
no deletion, receipt or audit is created

pagination: keyset/cursor pagination with stable ordered identity tiebreaker; exact totals returned separately where UI requires them
